Vayne

ADC Weird but works

Hypercarry ADC Vayne

How to play this build

Weak laning phase: farm safe and use Tumble (Q) to position your three Silver Bolts hits on the same target. In teamfights, kite with Q, condemn divers into walls, and activate the ult to go invisible on each tumble. Your win condition is the late-game 1v9 if you scale well.

Skill order

Max priority:

W Virotes de Plata → Q Voltereta → E Condenar

The ultimate (R) is always leveled at 6, 11 and 16.

Level 123456789101112131415161718
Q QQQQQ
W WWWWW
E EEEEE
R RRR
Why this order
Silver Bolts (W) for the true damage that melts tanks; Tumble (Q) second for repositioning. E (stun) at 1 point.

Items and what they do

  1. Berserker's Greaves Boots granting attack speed.
  2. Blade of the Ruined King % max-health on-hit and lifesteal; active steals move speed. Melts tanks.
  3. Phantom Dancer Attack speed, crit and move speed; ignores unit collision.
  4. Infinity Edge High AD, crit and increased crit damage. Core of almost every ADC.
  5. The Bloodthirster High AD and lifesteal; forms a shield when at full health.
  6. Frozen Mallet Lots of health and some AD; your auto-attacks slow the target (permaslow).

Masteries: how they work

In Season 3 you have up to 30 points (at level 30) to split across three trees: Offense (damage), Defense (durability) and Utility (mana, cooldown reduction and mobility). The notation 21/0/9 means 21 points in Offense, 0 in Defense and 9 in Utility.

Masteries
21/9/0 — Offense
Why this page
21/9/0 boosts sustained DPS; the durability helps duel up close on Vayne.
